newsitem.title: USA: Siemens' U.S. unit fiscal Q1 orders rise.
newsitem.headline: Siemens' U.S. unit fiscal Q1 orders rise.

text.p: Siemens AG said on Monday that global orders at its U.S. business units rose 6.3 percent to $2.21 billion for the 1996/97 fiscal first quarter ended December 31 1996 from $2.08 billion a year ago.

Sales fell 2.7 percent to $1.81 billion from $1.86 billion over the same period. Siemens said the sales fall followed a decline in the semiconductor market and in the large project power generation and transportation markets.
Employee numbers rose to 46,817 from 46,748 a year earlier. The parent company reported its fiscal first quarter results on January 28. ((-- New York Newsrom 212 859 1610))
